cause_of_death: Blunt force trauma to cranial region
report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Divya Krishnan | Age: 51
Body Temperature at Scene: 25.2°C | Ambient Temperature: 21.0°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 8.1 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Dorsal: Pattern bruising consistent with impact [MODERATE]
  2. Abdominal: Blunt force trauma with splenic laceration [MODERATE]
  3. Facial: Periorbital ecchymosis bilateral [MODERATE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): Chloroform, Opiates, GHB

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed posterior — no repositioning detected.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a spontaneous violent altercation. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
